title: Rachel Zegler, come get your Tony girl!!!  #Evita #RachelZegler #West...
transcript: I don't know if anyone else has noticed and obsessed over this, the official Evita account that they used during their West End run has completely scrubbed their Instagram. It now shows zero posts and they changed their profile picture and added the tagline the truth is I never left you. Now if that wasn't enough to convince you of a potential Broadway transfer, there have also been these posters spotted around New York City. This was posted by Hey Arthur NYC and look who reposted it. Rachel Zegler herself. So definitely seems like we could be seeing an announcement coming very soon.
